Subject: QBR prep: forecast reconciliation & account-by-account rundowns

Team / Sarah —

Starting a thread to pull together the QBR materials for Atlas Health and a couple of priority midmarket accounts. Leadership wants a compact one-pager per account (current ARR, committed timeline, topline risks, next 3 milestones) and a reconciled forecast that shows any deltas between AE projections and the finance-run numbers.

Ask list: 
- Marissa: can you run the forecast reconciliation and attach the delta spreadsheet by Thursday EOD (separate sheet per account)?
- Laura: please draft the one-pagers for Atlas and two other strategic accounts (Greenshepherd Labs, HorizonRx) — focus on decision drivers and upcoming POCs.
- Vivek: capture any OKR/leadership asks that need to be raised in the QBR (credits, SLA exceptions, risk signals).

Sarah — appreciate the context call last week. If there are any procurement deadlines we should know about for Atlas (purchase orders, security artifacts), flag them here so we can include in the leadership notes.

I'll compile everything into a single QBR packet for review on Friday.

Thanks,
Ben

Ben / team —

Quick OKR alignment note: for the QBR deck please surface the following two leadership asks tied to our FY27 Q3 OKRs:
1) One-time onboarding credit for Atlas Health (up to $50k) to accelerate POC acceptance — ties to OKR: "Reduce time-to-value for top-10 prospects."
2) Approval to deploy a dedicated SLA monitoring hook for Atlas (ops resource week of 7/18) — ties to OKR: "Improve reliability SLO coverage on high-value customers."
